# API catalog

Each name links to its source, where the JSDoc has full details and an example.

## Sources: create streams

| Name | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`backoff`](../../src/sources/backoff.ts) | Builds an exponential backoff schedule for `retry()`'s `delay`: `baseMs`, then multiplied by `factor` for each retry, capped at `maxMs`. |
| [`createStream`](../../src/sources/create-stream.ts) | Creates a stream from a producer function, like `new Observable()` in RxJS. |
| [`defer`](../../src/sources/defer.ts) | Calls `factory` when the first value is read and emits the values of the stream it returns. |
| [`empty`](../../src/sources/empty.ts) | Completes immediately without emitting. |
| [`EOF`](../../src/sources/external.ts) | Pass to an `external()` `next` function to complete the stream. |
| [`external`](../../src/sources/external.ts) | Creates a stream you feed from outside: call `next(value)` to emit, `next(EOF)` or `complete()` to finish, `error(reason)` to fail. |
| [`fromAsyncFunction`](../../src/sources/from-async-function.ts) | Calls `f` and emits the value it resolves to. |
| [`fromAsyncIterable`](../../src/sources/from-async-iterable.ts) | Emits each value of an async iterable, one per read. |
| [`fromEventPattern`](../../src/sources/from-event-pattern.ts) | Creates a stream from any callback-registration API. |
| [`fromEvent`](../../src/sources/from-event.ts) | Emits every event of type `name` dispatched on `target`. |
| [`fromFetch`](../../src/sources/from-fetch.ts) | Calls `fetch(input, init)` and emits the `Response`, then completes, like RxJS's `fromFetch`. |
| [`fromGenerator`](../../src/sources/from-generator.ts) | Emits the values of a generator function. |
| [`fromIterable`](../../src/sources/from-iterable.ts) | Emits each value of a synchronous iterable, one per read. |
| [`fromNext`](../../src/sources/from-next.ts) | Creates a stream by handing its `next` function to `f`. |
| [`fromPromise`](../../src/sources/from-promise.ts) | Emits the promise's value and completes, or errors if it rejects. |
| [`fromSubscribable`](../../src/sources/from-subscribable.ts) | Adapts an RxJS `Observable`, a TC39 `Observable`, or anything else with a `subscribe({ next, error, complete })` method. |
| [`from`](../../src/sources/from.ts) | Converts a stream, promise, iterable, or async iterable into a stream. |
| [`generate`](../../src/sources/generate.ts) | Emits values produced by a `for`-loop-shaped description, one per read. |
| [`iif`](../../src/sources/iif.ts) | Calls `condition` when the first value is read, then mirrors `trueResult` or `falseResult`. |
| [`interval`](../../src/sources/interval.ts) | Emits 0, 1, 2, … every `ms` milliseconds until cancelled. |
| [`never`](../../src/sources/never.ts) | Never emits, errors, or completes. |
| [`of`](../../src/sources/of.ts) | Emits the given values in order, then completes. |
| [`partition`](../../src/sources/partition.ts) | Splits one stream into two: values that satisfy `predicate`, and the rest. |
| [`range`](../../src/sources/range.ts) | Emits `count` consecutive integers starting at `start`. |
| [`repeatValue`](../../src/sources/repeat-value.ts) | Emits `value` forever, once per read. |
| [`repeat`](../../src/sources/repeat.ts) | Emits the values of `factory()`, then of a fresh `factory()` each time the previous stream completes, `count` streams in all. |
| [`retry`](../../src/sources/retry.ts) | Emits the values of `factory()`, and calls `factory()` again for a fresh stream each time one errors, up to `count` times. |
| [`shareReplay`](../../src/sources/share-replay.ts) | Like `share()`, but each new branch first receives the most recent values, and branches created after the source ends replay them and then end the same way. |
| [`share`](../../src/sources/share.ts) | Lets several consumers read one stream. |
| [`throwError`](../../src/sources/throw-error.ts) | Errors with the value `errorFactory` returns, when the first value is read. |
| [`timer`](../../src/sources/timer.ts) | Emits `0` once after `ms` milliseconds, then completes. |
| [`using`](../../src/sources/using.ts) | Creates a resource, emits the stream built from it, and releases the resource exactly once when that stream ends for any reason. |

## Combiners: many streams into one

| Name | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`combineLatest`](../../src/combiners/combine-latest.ts) | Once every source has emitted, emits an array of each source's latest value whenever any source emits. |
| [`concat`](../../src/combiners/concat.ts) | Emits every value of the first source, then every value of the next, and so on. |
| [`forkJoin`](../../src/combiners/fork-join.ts) | Waits for every source to complete, then emits one array of each source's last value. |
| [`merge`](../../src/combiners/merge.ts) | Emits every value from every source as it arrives. |
| [`onErrorResumeNext`](../../src/combiners/on-error-resume-next.ts) | Emits every value of each source in turn, moving to the next source when one completes or errors. |
| [`race`](../../src/combiners/race.ts) | Mirrors whichever source acts first, whether it emits, completes, or errors. |
| [`zip`](../../src/combiners/zip.ts) | Emits arrays pairing the nth value of every source. |

## Operators: use with `pipeThrough()`

| Name | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`auditTime`](../../src/operators/audit-time.ts) | After a value arrives, waits `ms` milliseconds, then emits the most recent value. |
| [`audit`](../../src/operators/audit.ts) | When a value arrives, starts `durationSelector(value)` and ignores further timing until it emits; then emits the most recent value. |
| [`bounded`](../../src/operators/bounded.ts) | Reads the source as fast as it produces and holds at most `buffer` values for the reader. |
| [`bufferCount`](../../src/operators/buffer-count.ts) | Collects values into arrays of `size`. |
| [`bufferTime`](../../src/operators/buffer-time.ts) | Emits arrays of the values collected over `bufferTimeSpan` ms. |
| [`bufferToggle`](../../src/operators/buffer-toggle.ts) | Starts collecting values into a new array each time `openings` emits, and emits that array when `closingSelector(openValue)` emits. |
| [`bufferWhen`](../../src/operators/buffer-when.ts) | Collects values into an array until the stream from `closingSelector()` emits, then emits the array and starts the next one with a fresh closing stream. |
| [`buffer`](../../src/operators/buffer.ts) | Collects source values and emits them as an array each time `notifier` emits, even if the array is empty. |
| [`catchError`](../../src/operators/catch-error.ts) | If the source errors, continues with the stream returned by `handler(error)`. |
| [`combineLatestAll`](../../src/operators/combine-latest-all.ts) | Takes a stream of streams, waits for it to complete, then combines the inner streams with `combineLatest()`. |
| [`combineLatestWith`](../../src/operators/combine-latest-with.ts) | Combines the source with `others`, emitting the latest value of each. |
| [`concatAll`](../../src/operators/concat-all.ts) | Takes a stream of streams and emits every value of each inner stream in order, starting the next only after the previous completes. |
| [`concatMap`](../../src/operators/concat-map.ts) | Maps each value to a stream and emits their values in order, one stream at a time. |
| [`concatWith`](../../src/operators/concat-with.ts) | Emits the source's values, then the values of each of `others` in turn. |
| [`count`](../../src/operators/count.ts) | Emits how many values satisfied `predicate` (or how many there were) when the source completes. |
| [`csv`](../../src/operators/csv.ts) | Parses CSV (RFC 4180) from a stream of text chunks into rows of strings. |
| [`debounceTime`](../../src/operators/debounce-time.ts) | Emits a value only after `ms` milliseconds pass without another value. |
| [`debounce`](../../src/operators/debounce.ts) | Like `debounceTime()`, but each value chooses its own quiet period: the value is emitted when `durationSelector(value)` emits, unless a newer value arrives first. |
| [`defaultIfEmpty`](../../src/operators/default-if-empty.ts) | Passes values through, or emits `defaultValue` if the source completes without emitting. |
| [`delayWhen`](../../src/operators/delay-when.ts) | Delays each value until `durationSelector(value, index)` emits. |
| [`delay`](../../src/operators/delay.ts) | Shifts every value, and completion, later by `ms` milliseconds while keeping the gaps between values. |
| [`dematerialize`](../../src/operators/dematerialize.ts) | Turns `Notification` objects back into values, an error, or completion. |
| [`distinctUntilChanged`](../../src/operators/distinct-until-changed.ts) | Drops a value if it equals the previous one. |
| [`distinctUntilKeyChanged`](../../src/operators/distinct-until-key-changed.ts) | Drops a value if its `key` property equals the previous value's. |
| [`distinct`](../../src/operators/distinct.ts) | Emits each value only the first time it is seen. |
| [`elementAt`](../../src/operators/element-at.ts) | Emits the value at position `index` (from 0) and completes, cancelling the source. |
| [`endWith`](../../src/operators/end-with.ts) | Emits `values` after the source completes. |
| [`every`](../../src/operators/every.ts) | Emits `false` and completes at the first value that fails `predicate`, cancelling the source, or emits `true` when the source completes. |
| [`exhaustAll`](../../src/operators/exhaust-all.ts) | Takes a stream of streams and emits values from one inner stream at a time. |
| [`exhaustMap`](../../src/operators/exhaust-map.ts) | Maps a value to a stream and emits from it, ignoring values that arrive while that stream is still active. |
| [`expand`](../../src/operators/expand.ts) | Emits each source value, then projects it to a stream whose values are emitted and projected in turn, recursively. |
| [`filter`](../../src/operators/filter.ts) | Emits only the values for which `predicate(value, index)` is true. |
| [`finalize`](../../src/operators/finalize.ts) | Calls `f` once when the stream ends for any reason: completion, error, or cancellation by the consumer. |
| [`findIndex`](../../src/operators/find-index.ts) | Emits the index of the first value that satisfies `predicate` and completes, cancelling the source, or emits `-1` if none does. |
| [`find`](../../src/operators/find.ts) | Emits the first value that satisfies `predicate` and completes, cancelling the source, or emits `undefined` if none does. |
| [`first`](../../src/operators/first.ts) | Emits the first value that satisfies `predicate` (or the first value at all), then completes and cancels the source. |
| [`groupBy`](../../src/operators/group-by.ts) | Splits values into groups by `keySelector`, emitting each group as a stream with a `key` property the first time its key appears. |
| [`ignoreElements`](../../src/operators/ignore-elements.ts) | Drops every value, keeping only completion and errors. |
| [`isEmpty`](../../src/operators/is-empty.ts) | Emits `false` and completes at the first value, cancelling the source, or emits `true` if the source completes without one. |
| [`last`](../../src/operators/last.ts) | Emits the last value that satisfies `predicate` (or the last value at all) when the source completes. |
| [`lines`](../../src/operators/lines.ts) | Splits a stream of text chunks into lines, accepting `\n` and `\r\n` line endings even when they straddle chunks. |
| [`map`](../../src/operators/map.ts) | Emits `project(value, index)` for each value. |
| [`materialize`](../../src/operators/materialize.ts) | Turns each value, and the final completion or error, into a `Notification` object. |
| [`max`](../../src/operators/max.ts) | Emits the largest value when the source completes, comparing with `comparer` (default: `<` and `>`). |
| [`mergeAll`](../../src/operators/merge-all.ts) | Takes a stream of streams and emits values from all of them as they arrive, reading at most `concurrent` inner streams at once. |
| [`mergeMap`](../../src/operators/merge-map.ts) | Maps each value to a stream and emits from all of them as values arrive, reading at most `concurrent` streams at once. |
| [`mergeScan`](../../src/operators/merge-scan.ts) | Like `scan()`, but the accumulator returns a stream. |
| [`mergeWith`](../../src/operators/merge-with.ts) | Emits values from the source and from `others` as they arrive. |
| [`min`](../../src/operators/min.ts) | Emits the smallest value when the source completes, comparing with `comparer` (default: `<` and `>`). |
| [`ndjson`](../../src/operators/ndjson.ts) | Parses newline-delimited JSON from a stream of text chunks: one value per line, blank lines skipped. |
| [`onErrorResumeNextWith`](../../src/operators/on-error-resume-next-with.ts) | Emits the source's values, then each of `others` in turn, moving on when one completes or errors. |
| [`pairwise`](../../src/operators/pairwise.ts) | Emits `[previous, current]` for each value after the first. |
| [`raceWith`](../../src/operators/race-with.ts) | Mirrors whichever of the source and `others` acts first, cancelling the rest. |
| [`reduce`](../../src/operators/reduce.ts) | Folds every value into an accumulator and emits the result when the source completes. |
| [`responseText`](../../src/operators/response-text.ts) | Streams each response's body as decoded text chunks. |
| [`sampleTime`](../../src/operators/sample-time.ts) | Every `ms` milliseconds, emits the most recent value if a new one arrived since the last sample. |
| [`sample`](../../src/operators/sample.ts) | Each time `notifier` emits, emits the most recent source value if a new one arrived since the last sample. |
| [`scan`](../../src/operators/scan.ts) | Emits each intermediate result of folding values into an accumulator. |
| [`sequenceEqual`](../../src/operators/sequence-equal.ts) | Emits whether the source and `compareTo` emit equal values in the same order and the same number of them. |
| [`single`](../../src/operators/single.ts) | Emits the only value that satisfies `predicate` (or the only value at all) when the source completes. |
| [`skipLast`](../../src/operators/skip-last.ts) | Drops the last `count` values. |
| [`skipUntil`](../../src/operators/skip-until.ts) | Drops source values until `notifier` emits, then emits the rest. |
| [`skipWhile`](../../src/operators/skip-while.ts) | Drops values while `predicate` holds, then emits every value from the first one that fails it. |
| [`skip`](../../src/operators/skip.ts) | Drops the first `count` values and emits the rest. |
| [`split`](../../src/operators/split.ts) | Splits a stream of text chunks on `separator`, emitting each piece. |
| [`sse`](../../src/operators/sse.ts) | Parses a `text/event-stream` (Server-Sent Events) from text chunks, following the WHATWG rules: `\r`, `\n`, and `\r\n` line endings, even across chunks; `:` comment lines; a leading byte-order mark; multi-line data. |
| [`startWith`](../../src/operators/start-with.ts) | Emits `values` before anything from the source. |
| [`subchain`](../../src/operators/subchain.ts) | Packages part of a pipeline as one reusable operator. |
| [`switchAll`](../../src/operators/switch-all.ts) | Takes a stream of streams and emits values from the most recent one, cancelling the previous inner stream each time a new one arrives. |
| [`switchMap`](../../src/operators/switch-map.ts) | Maps each value to a stream and emits from the most recent one only. |
| [`switchScan`](../../src/operators/switch-scan.ts) | Like `scan()`, but the accumulator returns a stream, and a new value cancels the previous accumulator stream. |
| [`takeLast`](../../src/operators/take-last.ts) | Emits the last `count` values when the source completes. |
| [`takeUntil`](../../src/operators/take-until.ts) | Emits source values until `notifier` emits, then completes and cancels both. |
| [`takeWhile`](../../src/operators/take-while.ts) | Emits values while `predicate(value, index)` holds, then completes and cancels the source. |
| [`take`](../../src/operators/take.ts) | Emits the first `count` values, then completes and cancels the source. |
| [`tap`](../../src/operators/tap.ts) | Calls `f` with each value for its side effect and passes the value on unchanged. |
| [`throttleTime`](../../src/operators/throttle-time.ts) | Emits at most one value per `ms` milliseconds. |
| [`throttle`](../../src/operators/throttle.ts) | Emits a value, then ignores values until `durationSelector(value)` emits. |
| [`throwIfEmpty`](../../src/operators/throw-if-empty.ts) | Passes values through, or errors with `errorFactory()` (default: `EmptyError`) if the source completes without emitting. |
| [`timeInterval`](../../src/operators/time-interval.ts) | Wraps each value with the milliseconds elapsed since the previous value, or since the stream started for the first. |
| [`timeout`](../../src/operators/timeout.ts) | Errors with `TimeoutError`, and cancels the source, if it is silent too long. |
| [`timestamp`](../../src/operators/timestamp.ts) | Wraps each value with the time it passed through, from `Date.now()`. |
| [`toArray`](../../src/operators/to-array.ts) | Emits one array of every value when the source completes. |
| [`toSse`](../../src/operators/to-sse.ts) | Encodes values as a `text/event-stream` for a server response. |
| [`windowCount`](../../src/operators/window-count.ts) | Splits the source into windows of `windowSize` values, each a stream. |
| [`windowTime`](../../src/operators/window-time.ts) | Splits the source into windows, each a stream lasting `windowTimeSpan` ms. |
| [`windowToggle`](../../src/operators/window-toggle.ts) | Opens a new window, emitted as a stream, each time `openings` emits, and completes it when `closingSelector(openValue)` emits. |
| [`windowWhen`](../../src/operators/window-when.ts) | Splits the source into consecutive windows. |
| [`window`](../../src/operators/window.ts) | Splits the source into consecutive windows, each a stream of its own. |
| [`withLatestFrom`](../../src/operators/with-latest-from.ts) | Pairs each source value with the latest value of every stream in `others`, as `[value, ...latest]`. |
| [`zipAll`](../../src/operators/zip-all.ts) | Takes a stream of streams, waits for it to complete, then pairs the inner streams' values by position with `zip()`. |
| [`zipWith`](../../src/operators/zip-with.ts) | Pairs each source value with the value at the same position in `others`. |

## Sinks: consume streams

| Name | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`collect`](../../src/sinks/collect.ts) | Reads the whole stream and resolves with an array of its values. |
| [`firstValueFrom`](../../src/sinks/first-value-from.ts) | Resolves with the stream's first value, then cancels the stream. |
| [`lastValueFrom`](../../src/sinks/last-value-from.ts) | Reads the whole stream and resolves with its last value. |
| [`subscribe`](../../src/sinks/subscribe.ts) | Creates the end of a pipeline: a `WritableStream` for `pipeTo()` that calls `next` for each value. |
| [`toResponse`](../../src/sinks/to-response.ts) | Builds a `Response` whose body is the stream, for edge functions and servers (Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun, Node route handlers). |
| [`toSubscribable`](../../src/sinks/to-subscribable.ts) | Wraps a stream in the Observable `subscribe()` protocol, for libraries that consume it: Svelte stores, `zen-observable`, the TC39 `Observable.from()`. |

## Workers: run stages on other threads

| Name | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`inWorker`](../../src/workers/in-worker.ts) | Runs the operator registered as `name` with `serveOperators()` inside `worker`, on another thread. |
| [`receiveStream`](../../src/workers/receive-stream.ts) | Receives a stream sent with `sendStream()` from the other end of a `MessagePort`. |
| [`sendStream`](../../src/workers/send-stream.ts) | Sends a stream's values over `port` to a `receiveStream()` on the other side, one value per value the receiver asks for, so backpressure crosses threads. |
| [`serveOperators`](../../src/workers/serve-operators.ts) | Inside a worker, serves the operators that `inWorker()` asks for by name. |
